review_evidence: README describes a Lean 4 bitmap/PNG library with verified encode/decode support and proofs of functional correctness, termination, buffer safety, and format invariants.

The large Bitmap/Lemmas/Png subtree consists of fine-grained correctness lemmas for DEFLATE, filtering, chunks, palette handling, Adam7, and round trips; these are the mathematical/proof content of the project rather than generated reports.
Bitmap/Tests.lean and other test-named modules are formal Lean sources within the proof-bearing library, and FILTER-011 gives no basis for path-only removal; no safe hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the entire Bitmap Lean proof corpus; implementation, lemma, and test modules all contribute verified PNG/bitmap behavior.
